title: Retail and Catering

onscreen_lines.desc: RETAIL (RESTAURANTS INCLUDED) - DISCOUNT OFFERED Please provide a percentage of any discounts available to Mesquite ISD. If no discount, you must enter 0.
onscreen_lines.note: If a discount varies between products, you may put anywhere from 0-100% in the appropriate blank. If "varies", place 0 in the estimated percent and type "varies" in the notes field. If you are a restaurant (not catering) and charge a delivery fee, please put pricing information in notes.
onscreen_lines.block: 1 RETAIL (RESTAURANTS INCLUDED) - DISCOUNT OFFERED Please provide a percentage of any discounts available to Mesquite ISD. If no discount, you must enter 0. 1 EA No Response

onscreen_lines.desc: CATERING - DISCOUNT OFFERED Please provide a percentage of any discounts available to Mesquite ISD. If no discount you must enter 0.
onscreen_lines.note: Mesquite ISD understands that catering functions are different, and your pricing has many factors, you may leave 0.00 in the Estimated Price and state, "pricing available upon request" or, "Varies depending on service" in the Add Notes Field. Also, if you offer more than one service you can state the rates in the Add Notes Field.
